data.name: shield/splitscreen_signout_desc
data.value: Player 2 leaves the lobby and signs out. Everyone else stays.

data.name: hash_303cdaf1f38c88a4
data.value: This lobby is currently closed (Private Lobby)

data.name: shield/bots_wz_lives_desc
data.value: Toggle if Bots can respawn after being killed (5 lives for each bot).

data.name: shield/perfor_mode_frontend_desc
data.value: Disables most of the scenes in frontend, to improve performance.

data.name: shield/show_script_desc
data.value: Displays the usage of script variables/level entities/element pool size/etc in the screen, useful for debugging. (needs restarting)

data.name: shield/slide_desc
data.value: Adjusts the slide cooldown for all modes. (Default is 10)

data.name: shield/prevent_dw_disconnect_desc
data.value: Makes it that you can not get disconnected from the game at all, but you won't be able to join public matches or level up progression if you are disconnected! (useful for zombies high rounds - restart required)

data.name: shield/offline_perks_desc
data.value: Same as PS4/5 Offline mode, disables the online perks in zombies, so you can use the offline perks only. (Blood Wolf Bite, Blaze Phase, Zombshell, Host Only)

data.name: shield/use_wz_alts_desc
data.value: Changes Blackout Maps (Must be Host, use only for custom games!)

data.name: shield/alt_movement_desc
data.value: Turns on the movement changes below. Needs a restart, and makes the GSC/CSC checksum always show red. The changes below apply at once while this is on.

data.name: shield/mv_omni_desc
data.value: Sprint in any direction you move, not only forward.

data.name: shield/mv_strafe_desc
data.value: How fast you sprint sideways and backwards with Omni Movement, as a share of the forward sprint. The original game's is 67%.

data.name: shield/mv_jump_cooldown_desc
data.value: How soon after a jump you can jump again. The original game waits half a second.

data.name: shield/mv_sprint_ramp_desc
data.value: How long you sprint before a jump gets the full boost of the sprint. The original game takes one and a half seconds.

data.name: shield/mv_instant_slide_desc
data.value: Slides start at once, without the original game's check before a slide.

data.name: shield/mv_jump_slowdown_desc
data.value: Jumps keep your speed, instead of the original game slowing you down after each one.

data.name: shield/mv_landing_friction_desc
data.value: Less friction right after you land from a jump.

data.name: shield/mv_slide_chaining_desc
data.value: Slides in a row keep their speed, with or without the PHD Flopper perk, instead of each one being slower.

data.name: shield/unlock_loot_desc
data.value: Unlocks Loot and Sets Max Elixirs in Zombies

data.name: shield/unlock_camos_desc
data.value: Unlocks All Weapon's Camos and All Calling Cards

data.name: shield/unlock_items_desc
data.value: Unlocks All Weapons, and Some Other Stuff

data.name: shield/unlockclassslots_desc
data.value: Unlocks The Extra Class Slots in Multiplayer (12 Class Slots in Total)

data.name: shield/gametype/freerun_desc
data.value: Race the checkpoints of a course with the grapple. No damage, no time limit: just you and the clock.

data.name: shield/gametype/targetrange_desc
data.value: Test your loadout on bots that stand still. No time limit, no score limit.

data.name: shield/bothard_desc
data.value: Adds an Extra Bots (18 in Total if with All Bots), and Sets the Extra Bots to a Very Hard Mode

data.name: shield/ip_notice
data.value: IP has been Set!, You can reconnect from main menu.

data.name: shield/watermark_main_desc
data.value: Displays a text in top right that says Shield: <version>. (Restart Required)

data.name: shield/watermark_main_mods_desc
data.value: Displays a mod loaded list with hashes next to the Shield Text Watermark. (Restart Required)

data.name: shield/watermark_main_checksum_desc
data.value: Displays a GSC/CSC checksum under the Shield Text Watermark. (Restart Required)

data.name: shield/watermark_main_flash_hashes_desc
data.value: Displays loaded and raw mod files and their hashes in starting game of zombies. (Restart Required)

data.name: shield/aimassist_lock_desc
data.value: Enables Aim Assist Lock-on, (Note: Only for Zombies Mode)

data.name: shield/aimassist_slow_desc
data.value: Enables Aim Assist Slowdown when Aiming

data.name: shield/aimassist_closetarget_desc
data.value: Target the closest AI based on 3d distance, (Note: Only for Zombies Mode)

data.name: shield/blureffect_desc
data.value: Changes the style of Main Menu, needs restarting

data.name: shield/roundcnt_desc
data.value: Changes the counter logic of Rounds in zombies, (Might be buggy for mod menus if you revert the round, also does not work in theater mode.)

data.name: shield/checksum_desc
data.value: Shows the checksum value of GSC/CSC scripts, needs restarting.

data.name: shield/botsrandom_desc
data.value: Makes the bots have random skins and camos, other stuff.

data.name: shield/discordrpc_desc
data.value: Shows game status info in your discord profile, needs restarting

data.name: hash_1d39f140af582e3a
data.value:
Welcome to Shield Client, Play respectfully and have fun. 
to mute chat, type /mute, to unmute, type /unmute.

data.name: shield/fovscale_desc
data.value: Adjust the FOV, Aspect Ratio, Gun POS, and viewmodel scale. (Requires Restart to Enable, Commands in Chat: /fov [scale - default: 1.0], for viewmodel scale: /viewmodel [fov number - default: 90.0], for aspect ratio: /ratio [scale - default: 1.0], for moving the gun around: /gunx [scale - default: 0.0], /guny [scale - default: 0.0], /gunz [scale - default: 0.0], Will make the gsc/csc checksum always red!)

data.name: shield/fov_forceADS_desc
data.value: Makes the FOV Scale ignore ADS FOV (when aiming down sights)

data.name: shield/bot_skill_desc
data.value: How good the bots are overall. The settings below follow it unless you set them yourself. Game Default leaves the bots as the game has them. Applies from the next match.

data.name: shield/bot_aim_desc
data.value: How exact and how fast bots aim. Aimbot turns a bot onto the nearest enemy it has a clear line to, whichever way it looks, and fires at once.

data.name: shield/bot_reaction_desc
data.value: How soon bots stop what they are doing to deal with an enemy, and how long snipers wait before the shot. The two fastest also aim, reload and come out of a sprint faster, and the fastest fires while sprinting.

data.name: shield/bot_awareness_desc
data.value: How wide bots see and how close an enemy has to come to be noticed whichever way they look.

data.name: shield/bot_headshots_desc
data.value: How often bots go for the head. With Aimbot they only do so once they aim down the sights, and go for the chest from the hip, where a head is too small to hit.

data.name: shield/bot_objectives_desc
data.value: Gives bots an objective plan in every variant of Domination, Hardpoint, Control and Search and Destroy, and sends a bot into the objective itself as soon as the plan does not get it there.

data.name: shield/bm_rewards_desc
data.value: Earn Reserve Cases and season tiers by playing matches. Off turns off all of the earning below.

data.name: shield/bm_case_minutes_desc
data.value: Time played in matches, of any mode, for one Reserve Case. The original game filled a bar with time played, about one case an hour.

data.name: shield/bm_cases_per_match_desc
data.value: Extra Reserve Cases at the end of every match, on top of the time. Not in the original game.

data.name: shield/bm_tier_per_match_desc
data.value: The season pass and the active contract go up one tier at the end of every match.

data.name: shield/bm_season_desc
data.value: Which season the black market and its pass show. Each season keeps its own tier. (Restart Required)

data.name: shield/bm_season_rewards_desc
data.value: Reaching a tier of the season pass gives its reward. Off lets you look through the pass without being given anything.

data.name: shield/bm_consume_desc
data.value: Openings and bribes take their price in COD Points, cases or crates. Free opens them without taking anything.

data.name: shield/bm_bribe_crates_desc
data.value: Duplicate Protected Crates given with every weapon bribe. The original game gave 5.

data.name: shield/realst_zm_desc
data.value: in Zombies, Complete every maps's quests on realistic

data.name: shield/wz_uav_desc
data.value: Enables infinite uav for all players to help with finding bots

data.name: shield/hard_zm_desc
data.value: in Voyage Of Despair, Complete the quest on realistic without using any perks, elixirs, or talismans.

data.name: shield/fanofshit_desc
data.value: in Zombies (any map), Reach round 50 on hardcore or above

data.name: shield/fuckshit_desc
data.value: in Zombies, die after popping a Perkaholic

data.name: shield/lab_titanium_treble_desc
data.value: Get 3 Elixirs, 3 of each. At least one is Rare or better.

data.name: shield/lab_selenium_selection_desc
data.value: Get 3 Elixirs: 2 Rare or better and 1 Legendary or better. A chance of a Talisman.

data.name: shield/lab_rhodium_roundup_desc
data.value: Get 3 random Elixirs and a Talisman.

data.name: shield/lab_tungsten_tripler_desc
data.value: Get 3 Elixirs that are Rare or better, 3 of each, and 3 of a Talisman.

data.value: You already have the maximum number of 10 items. Choose an item to remove, it will be replaced with your selected item.

data.value: Reticles will appear here when acquired

data.name: hash_6f11efca50b790eb
data.value: Charms will appear here when acquired.

data.name: hash_79b15b2a5e21491c
data.value: Reactive Camos will appear here when acquired

data.name: hash_63da6ea5d502cf7d
data.value: Gamepad aim assist is available in Shield Client.

data.name: hash_4e3c597d83bc0cfa
data.value: Send a friend request by entering a player's username. If several players share that name, add # and the last digits of their XUID, like Name#1234. They don't have to be online right now, but must have been online on Shield at least once.

data.value: You do not have this custom map. You can try downloading it from Mod Manager in Main Menu..
